name: Adventures of Superman
description: It's a bird! It's a plane! It's a syndicated TV adaptation of the beloved DC Comics superhero! You know the drill: When he isn't fighting for truth, justice and the American way, the man in tights dons a suit and glasses for his secret identity as Daily Planet newspaper reporter Clark Kent, who works alongside friends Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen for gruff boss Perry White.

videos.title: First Lady of Metropolis
videos.overview: Profiling Noel Neill and the character of Lois Lane.

videos.title: Stamp Day for Superman
videos.overview: Special Episode promoting Savings Bonds with a new introduction by Jack Larson (Jimmy Olsen).

videos.title: Kellogg's Commercials
videos.overview: Original Kellogg's Cereal TV commercials starring Adventures of Superman cast members.

videos.title: Pony Express Days
videos.overview: George Reeves Played many parts before donning Superman's signature red and blue as television's first Man of Steel.  1940's "Pony Express Days" features the young actor in the role of William "Buffalo Bill" Cody and stands as yet another example of Reeves' talent, energy and charisma.

videos.title: Adventures of Superman: The Color Era
videos.overview: A documentary on the transition from filming the series in black and white to color even though all the seasons aired in black and white.

videos.title: Faster Than a Speeding Bullet: The Special Effects of Adventures of Superman
videos.overview: An extra discussing the special effects of Adventures of Superman.

videos.title: Look, Up in the Sky!  The Amazing Story of Superman
videos.overview: Excerpts from the new documentary produced by Bryan Singer and Kevin Burns.

videos.title: Superman: Brainiac Attacks
videos.overview: The original Movie Trailer.

videos.title: Superman's Pal: Jimmy Olsen
videos.overview: Jack Larson celebrates his series character along with co-star Noel Neill and Author/Historians Jim Beaver, Gary Grossman, Michael J Hayde and Jan Henderson.

videos.title: Hollywoodland
videos.overview: A detective (Adrien Brody) uncovers unexpected links to his own personal life as he probes the mysterious death of "Superman" actor George Reeves (Ben Affleck) in 1959. A possible affair between the actor and Toni Mannix (Diane Lane), the wife of a studio executive (Bob Hoskins), might reveal the truth.

videos.title: From Inkwell to Backlot
videos.overview: A series retrospective featuring Jack Larson (Jimmy Olsen), Leonard Maltin (Movie Historian/Critic), Gary H. Grossman (Author of Superman: Serial to Cereal), Paul Levitz (DC Comics President), Allan Asherman (DC Comics Historian), Dan Didio (DC Comics Editor), Mike Carlin (Superman Comic Editor), and Alex Ross (Superman Comic Artist).

videos.title: Superman on Earth
videos.overview: Journey with Superman from Krypton to Metropolis, as he joins that Daily Planet staff and meets the fiery Lois Lane.

videos.title: The Haunted Lighthouse
videos.overview:
A terrified Jimmy Olsen calls for help, and Superman speeds to an isolated island where strange things happen in the fog-shrouded night.

Commentary available by  TV Producer/Author Gary H. Grossman.

videos.title: The Case of the Talkative Dummy
videos.overview: As superman hunts for kidnapped armored-car drivers and a stolen fortune, Jimmy, loccked inside a falling safe, hurtles to his doom.

videos.title: Mystery of the Broken Statues
videos.overview: Lois Lane is kidnapped while on the trail of a suave but deadly criminal mastermind and a hidden priceless gem.

videos.title: The Monkey Mystery
videos.overview: Searching for stolen defense secrets, Clark Kent encounters a brutalized woman, a slain organ-grinder -- and a monkey dressed as Superman.

videos.title: Night of Terror
videos.overview: Superman races to find Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen who wait, helplessly bound, as a sadistic hit man prepares to execute them.

videos.title: The Birthday Letter
videos.overview: Superman is implicated in the abduction of a young girl who is thought to have information concerning hidden counterfeit plates.

videos.title: The Mind Machine
videos.overview: Bravely testifying against a mobster, Lois Lane will die unless Clark Kent finds the weapon that will soon destroy her mind.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: Trapped in a mine filling with deadly gas, Lois Lane is beyond the reach of rescuers -- and Clark Kent doesn't know!

videos.title: The Secret of Superman
videos.overview: An insane scientist, using powerful experimental truth drugs on Perry White, Lois Lane and Clark Kent, learns Superman's true identity.

videos.title: No Holds Barred
videos.overview: When a crooked wrestling promoter paralyzes honest athletes, Superman steps in to reverse the damage and rescue an innocent captive.

videos.title: The Deserted Village
videos.overview: As Clark Kent pursues the monster killing the few people left in Lois Lane's hometown, the girl reporter becomes its next victim.

videos.title: The Stolen Costume
videos.overview:
After a burglar steals Superman's costume from Clark Kent's closet, a mobster threatens to reveal the Man of Steel's secret identity.

Commentary available by  TV Producer/Author Gary H. Grossman.

videos.title: Treasure of the Incas
videos.overview: Unwittingly involved in a hunt for stolen radium, Jimmy is kidnapped and locked in a deathtrap by a fanatical doctor.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Lois and Jimmy follow a trail of murder that could lead to ancient riches -- or to their own deaths.

videos.title: Mystery in Wax
videos.overview: Lois Lane, chloroformed while investigating strange disappearances, is held prisoner in Madame Selina's wax museum of the living dead.

videos.title: Runaway Robot
videos.overview: Captive Lois Lane will be murdered by gangsters unless inventor Horatio Hinkle uses his unique radio-controlled robot to rob banks.

videos.title: Drums of Death
videos.overview: Aided by his ace reporters, Perry White flies to Haiti to search for his sister, the prisoner of a voodoo cult.

videos.title: The Evil Three
videos.overview:
Perry White and Jimmy Olsen face death at the hands of three crazed murderers in a crumbling bayou hotel.

Commentary available by Producer/Writer Chuck Harter.

videos.title: The Riddle of the Chinese Jade
videos.overview: Lois Lane is held hostage by the armed criminal who has stolen a priceless antique and left two people to drown.

videos.title: The Human Bomb
videos.overview: On a windswept narrow ledge high above the ground, Lois Lane is chained to a dynamite-wielding daredevil ready to die.

videos.title: Czar of the Underworld
videos.overview: A killer sabotaging the filming of a crime exposé stalks Clark Kent and Inspector Henderson on a Hollywood studio soundstage.

videos.title: Ghost Wolf
videos.overview: After discovering human footprints that turn into wolf tracks, Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen are trapped in a raging forest fire.

videos.title: Crime Wave
videos.overview:
While hunting down an anonymous crime-boss, the Man of Steel is lured into a lighting-powered deathtrap that stops his heart.

Commentary available by Producer/Writer Chuck Harter.

videos.title: The Unknown People (1)
videos.overview: Clark Kent and Lois Lane visit the world's deepest oil well in Silsby, when strange humanoid creatures appear and terrorize the townspeople.

videos.title: The Unknown People (2)
videos.overview: Convinced the Mole Men are peaceful beings, Superman must save them from a vengeful mob determined to kill the armed visitors.

videos.title: Five Minutes to Doom
videos.overview: Beat the clock:  The race is on to stop an innocent Death Row inmate's date with the electric chair.

videos.title: The Big Squeeze
videos.overview: A powerful ally: the Man of Steel assists an ex-con blackmailed into returning to his criminal past.

videos.title: The Man Who Could Read Minds
videos.overview: Swami says: send for Superman! Jimmy and Lois suspect a nightclub mind reader is linked to a theft ring.

videos.title: Jet Ace
videos.overview: Look up! Superman rescues a pilot on a test flight gone wrong and later frees him from kidnappers seeking military secrets.

videos.title: Shot in the Dark
videos.overview: An amateur shutterbug snaps some incriminating photos, one of which suggests Clark is you-know-who!

videos.title: The Defeat of Superman
videos.overview: Superman is rendered powerless by a kryptonite trap. This sounds like a job for...Lois and Jimmy?

videos.title: Superman in Exile
videos.overview: Beware of Superman! A nuclear incident leaves him glowing with radioactivity and lethal to anyone he's near.

videos.title: A Ghost for Scotland Yard
videos.overview: Man or spirit? A magician believed dead may have resurfaced in a vendetta against his earthly foes.

videos.title: The Dog Who Knew Superman
videos.overview: The nose knows. A dog rescued from a well by Superman keeps showing up at Clark Kent's office.

videos.title: The Face and the Voice
videos.overview: Looks like him. Sounds like him. But he isn't Superman! A lookalike Man of Steel goes on a crime spree.

videos.title: The Man in the Lead Mask
videos.overview: Surgically altered fingerprints. Lead masks to block x-ray vision. Will these foil the police and Superman?

videos.title: Panic in the Sky
videos.overview:
Destination: Earth! Superman saves Metropolis from a plummeting asteroid -- and loses his memory in the process.

Commentary available by Jack Larson (Jimmy Olsen) and Noel Neill (Lois Lane).

videos.title: The Machine That Could Plot Crimes
videos.overview: Meet Mr. Kelso, the computer that plans split second bank heists...and may know superman's secret, too.

videos.title: Jungle Devil
videos.overview: The superhero saves a lost expedition, defeats a fearsome beast and uses his grip to turn coal into diamonds.

videos.title: My Friend Superman
videos.overview: Burger, fries and friendship.  Not everyone believes a diner owner who boasts of being pals with Superman.

videos.title: The Clown Who Cried
videos.overview: What kind of clown would rob a kids' charity telethon? An imposter clown, that's who!

videos.title: The Boy Who Hated Superman
videos.overview: Clark is temporary guardian of a crime-connected youth who secretly plots revenge against the reporter.

videos.title: Semi-Private Eye
videos.overview:
Sam Spade. Philip Marlowe. Jimmy Olsen? He poses as a trench-coated private eye to stalk kidnappers.

Commentary available by Jack Larson (Jimmy Olsen) and Noel Neill (Lois Lane).

videos.title: Perry White's Scoop
videos.overview: Stop the presses! Frustrated by Daily Planet's reporters, Perry White decides to cover a murder story himself.

videos.title: Beware the Wrecker
videos.overview: A terrorist bombs Metropolis' transportation systems. His method: armed, radio-controlled toy airplanes.

videos.title: The Golden Vulture
videos.overview: Avast, ye scurvy mates! A salvage-boat captain who fancies himself a pirate holds Lois and Jimmy captive.

videos.title: Jimmy Olsen, Boy Editor
videos.overview: Great Caesar's ghost! Jimmy Olsen replaces Perry White for a day -- with dizzy and dangerous results.

videos.title: Lady in Black
videos.overview: Noises. Unusual people. Jimmy is sure something strange is going on at the apartment of his mom's friend.

videos.title: Star of Fate
videos.overview: A mystery from Egypt's past: the antidote to an ancient poison is under the base of the Great Pyramid.

videos.title: The Whistling Bird
videos.overview: The bird has the word. A per parakeet that knows an inventor's secret formula is mysteriously birdnapped.

videos.title: Around the World with Superman
videos.overview: Paging Dr. Superman! His x-ray vision helps a surgeon restore a girl's sight, then he flies her on a world tour.

videos.title: Through the Time Barrier
videos.overview: An inventor's time contraption whisks the Daily Planet staff to 50,000 B.C. One problem: how to get back!

videos.title: The Talking Clue
videos.overview: Sound and fury. Bank robbers have a sudden interest in a young audiophile's collection of recorded sounds.

videos.title: The Lucky Cat
videos.overview: Ladders, black cats, Friday the 13th. All harmless -- but someone intends real harm to an anti-superstition society.

videos.title: Superman Week
videos.overview: No dinners, no hoopla...just Kryptonite.  Two thugs have their own way of celebrating Superman Week.

videos.title: Great Caesar's Ghost
videos.overview: He claims to be Caesar. But who's really behind the strange apparition vexing Perry White?

videos.title: Test of a Warrior
videos.overview: Great Horse faces his tribe's test of valor -- with help from a spirit named Superman!

videos.title: Olsen's Millions
videos.overview: Gee, thanks! An elderly woman rewards Jimmy $1 million because she thinks he rescued her cat.

videos.title: Clark Kent, Outlaw
videos.overview: Clark Kent is the man on the inside, posing as an ace safecracker to get the goods on a crime ring.

videos.title: The Magic Necklace
videos.overview: Wear the necklace and it protects you from harm. Bullets even bounce off Clark when he wears it!

videos.title: The Bully of Dry Gulch
videos.overview: His town. His way. But a bogus gunslinger who rules a Western town is no match for the Man of Steel.

videos.title: Flight to the North
videos.overview: Good ol' boy Sylvester is mistaken for Superman.

videos.title: The Seven Souvenirs
videos.overview: Is something hidden inside them? Items purchased at a Superman souvenir store may be clues to a crime.

videos.title: King for a Day
videos.overview: A royal performance: Jimmy poses as a prince of Burgonia to help thwart an assassination plot.

videos.title: Joey
videos.overview: A day at the races: Superman fights track corruption and the Daily Planet's racehorse gallops to victory.

videos.title: The Unlucky Number
videos.overview: Guess the number of jelly beans in the jar. With superman's help, it's possible to win a fixed contest.

videos.title: The Big Freeze
videos.overview: They'll stop him cold! Thugs think a freezer will keep Superman on ice during a rigged election.

videos.title: Peril by Sea
videos.overview: Criminals aboard a submarine aim to torpedo Perry White and his seaside cottage to smithereens.

videos.title: Topsy Turvy
videos.overview: Which way is up? An invention that causes the illusion of being upside-down is stolen for villainous use.

videos.title: Jimmy the Kid
videos.overview: Who's that guy? Hoodlums kidnap Jimmy and put a tough-talking lookalike in his place at the Daily Planet.

videos.title: The Girl Who Hired Superman
videos.overview: Villains have Superman right where they want him when he attends a party for a visiting foreign dignitary.

videos.title: The Wedding of Superman
videos.overview: Superman pops the question, Lois says "yes". Is it a dream come true for the smitten femme reporter?

videos.title: Dagger Island
videos.overview: Three brothers, one fortune.  Its finders keepers as the trio hunt for a hidden family inheritance.

videos.title: Blackmail
videos.overview: A $500,000 heist -- and Inspector Henderson is the fall guy when some of the dough is planted on him.

videos.title: The Deadly Rock
videos.overview: Mobsters use Kryptonite to capture the Man of Steel -- or at least a man they think is Superman!

videos.title: The Phantom Ring
videos.overview: How do you stop thieves who have the power of invisibility? That's the new challenge facing Superman!

videos.title: The Jolly Roger
videos.overview: Shiver me timbers! Pirates hold Clark, Lois and Jimmy on a deserted isle the U.S. Navy intends to destroy.

videos.title: Peril in Paris
videos.overview: Good intentions gone bad. Superman helps a woman escape from behind the Iron Curtain...and inadvertently becomes a jewel smuggler.

videos.title: Tin Hero
videos.overview: A nose for news: A meek bookkeeper is an ace crime reporter -- with an occasional assist from Superman.

videos.title: The Town That Wasn't
videos.overview: You can't locate it on a map. What's the secret behind a tiny, mysterious, out-of-the-way town?

videos.title: The Tomb of Zaharan
videos.overview: She's the one. Members of a bizarre cult believe Lois is their ancient queen returned to life.

videos.title: The Man Who Made Dreams Come True
videos.overview: A bogus seer aims to make his own crooked dream come true - a plan to usurp the rule of a dotty monarch.

videos.title: Disappearing Lois
videos.overview: She'll get all the dirt. Lois goes undercover, posing as a housemaid to get a story on a notorious criminal.

videos.title: Money to Burn
videos.overview: Hot news: The arson suspect in a big warehouse fire is...Perry White!

videos.title: Close Shave
videos.overview: A shave, a haircut, a new you, maybe a new life. A barber has an unusual influence on others.

videos.title: The Phony Alibi
videos.overview: Dialed in: An inventor's new creation gives crooks the ability to zoom themselves through telephone lines.

videos.title: The Prince Albert Coat
videos.overview: Oops! A boy gives his grandpa's coat to charity, unaware it holds the man's life savings. Can Superman save the savings?

videos.title: The Stolen Elephant
videos.overview: And some kids just want a pony. A boy thinks the stolen circus elephant he finds is his birthday gift.

videos.title: Mr. Zero
videos.overview: He's not from around here: A pint-sized Martian has a power that may be useful to crooks.

videos.title: Whatever Goes Up
videos.overview: Jimmy Olsen: Scientist. The anti-gravity fluid he creates with his chemistry set draws interest from military men...and criminals.

videos.title: The Last Knight
videos.overview: A gentlemen's society of armored knights holds many secrets (and holds jimmy and Lois captive, too).

videos.title: The Magic Secret
videos.overview: Ready, Aim...A crimelord kidnaps Lois and Jimmy, using them as bait to lure our hero into the line of fire of a Kryptonite ray gun.

videos.title: Divide and Conquer
videos.overview: Are half powers better than none? To be in two places at one time, Superman rearranges his molecular density.

videos.title: The Mysterious Cube
videos.overview: Safe from justice? A killer hides inside a bunker made of a strange material even Superman can't penetrate.

videos.title: The Atomic Captive
videos.overview: The bomb explodes, a mushroom cloud rises...and Lois and Jimmy are stranded on the test site.

videos.title: The Superman Silver Mine
videos.overview: The kids can wait. Crooks attempt to claim a silver mine for themselves and keep it from becoming a summer camp.

videos.title: The Big Forget
videos.overview: An anti-memory vapor can be useful to villains...and perhaps to Clark Kent when he needs to conceal his heroics.

videos.title: The Gentle Monster
videos.overview: It means no harm. And may bring death to Superman. A newly created robot is powered by Kryptonite.

videos.title: Superman's Wife
videos.overview: Sorry, Lois. Superman unexpectedly marries a gorgeous blonde policewoman. But why?

videos.title: Three in One
videos.overview: Superman Arrested! While he's out of the way, three circus performers use their respective skills in a heist.

videos.title: The Brainy Burro
videos.overview: Jimmy and Lois: bank robbers. They're accused of a theft committed by thugs and a mind-reading burro.

videos.title: The Perils of Superman
videos.overview: Lois is tied to railroad track! Crooks in lead masks vow vengeance against the Daily Planet staff.

videos.title: All That Glitters
videos.overview: What if? After a whack to the head, Jimmy dreams he and Lois have the same powers as the Man of Steel.
